collections-v1.json.from: dist/collections-v1.js, the id and name of each entry

sources.license: The repository has no LICENSE file and no license field in package.json. It is Decentraland's own, like this one, and the extracted file holds factual catalogue data, not code; the Apache-2.0 LICENSE here covers the other sources.

wearables-v1.json.from: src/data/wearablesV1/<name>.ts, each exported Wearable[] array, in the order getWearableV1Representation searches them (src/modules/metadata/wearable/index.ts): {collection, wearables: [{id, name, description, category, rarity, bodyShapes}]}
wearables-v1.json.generator: python3 tooling/collections-v1-data.py wearables <collections-graph checkout at the revision> services/catalyst/content/src/validator/onchain/contracts/wearables-v1.json

collections-v1-symbols.json.from: symbol() of each collections-v1.json contract, one batched eth_call at the latest block (2026-11-26); a v1 collection's symbol is set by its constructor and never changes

normalization: Values extracted from the published npm tarballs with JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) plus a trailing newline; the bytecode is the hex string as published plus a trailing newline.
update_instructions: Install the pinned packages, re-extract the listed values as described in each files entry and update the sha256 values here.
Run cargo test -p catalyst-content validator::onchain, whose tests check the Rust call encodings against checker.abi.json.

wearables-v1.json: check out decentraland/collections-graph at the new revision, run the generator command in its files entry, update the revision and sha256 here, then run cargo test -p catalyst-content collections_v1 and cargo test -p catalyst-shop collections_v1. collections-v1-symbols.json changes only with collections-v1.json: rerun its generator command.
